text:
Nadia: quick heads-up before tonight's v2 wide rollout: compatibility test caught a schema mismatch on the /v2/complete response for some older server SDKs. A subset of tenants using server-sdk 0.9.x may see parse errors and 400s. Thinking we should pin those tenants and proceed for the rest.

deploy-bot: Planned deploy v2.5.0 -> region-eu-central in 35m. Staged 5%/25%/100% over 60m. No pins currently. :robot_face:

Ethan: saw the test failure. It's not model behavior, it's the JSON envelope: we added an optional "meta.tokens_used" field and older SDKs treat unknown top-level keys as errors. A pin seems reasonable.

Yvonne: how many tenants affected? Is it a large chunk?

Nadia: affected tenants are tenant-8, tenant-19, tenant-204 — mostly older enterprise customers we've migrated from the legacy proxy. Small set. I'll propose pin until tomorrow 12:00 UTC while we push a compatibility patch to SDKs and add a release-note note.

Kai: rollback criteria? If we continue and other tenants start erroring, what's our threshold to rollback the entire rollout vs pin more tenants?

Ethan: runbook suggestion:
- If global client 4xx on /v2/complete >1% sustained for 5m AND correlates to missing-field parse errors -> pause rollout and pin correlated tenants
- If global 5xx >0.5% for 3m OR model-level failures (invalid responses) occur -> rollback full region to last stable build
Prefer pause+pin and targeted fixes over full rollback.

Yvonne: can we apply pins atomically and then continue the slice? I want to avoid blocking the whole region.

Nadia: yes, we can. I'll run deploy-bot pin with all tenants in one command.

Nadia: /deploybot pin tenant-8,tenant-19,tenant-204 --reason "staging schema unknown-key parse errors server-sdk 0.9.x" --until 2026-03-24T12:00:00Z

deploy-bot: Pin request received for tenant-8, tenant-19, tenant 204. Please confirm one message listing tenants to execute. :eyes:

Ethan: confirm: /deploybot confirm-pin tenant-8,tenant-19,tenant-204 --note "hold for SDK patch and release notes"

deploy-bot: Pins applied: tenant-8, tenant-19, tenant-204 -> pinned to v1 until 2026-03-24T12:00:00Z. Action ID: c317f9. Rolling forward with remaining rollout targets.

Yvonne: adding a short release-note blurb: "v2 adds optional meta fields in responses; older server SDKs (<1.0) may reject unknown top-level keys. We recommend upgrading to server-sdk 1.0+ before switching to v2." Will push PR now.

Kai: ops: I'll watch the /v2/complete path and add an alert rule to silence noise from pinned tenants. If we see >2 additional tenants hit the same parse error within 30m, we pause and re-evaluate.

Ethan: quick patch plan: we'll add a server-side compatibility shim to avoid emitting the new meta field for requests from older SDKs, and cut a micro-release for the SDK teams to follow up. If shim doesn't clear the errors after unpin, we'll open a rollback.

Nadia: note for post-deploy: create a small postmortem ticket only if any pinned tenant sees >3 incidents in 48h after unpin. Otherwise close as "handled via pin + SDK upgrade".

Yvonne: PR created: docs/rollouts v2-compatibility-note (link: https://git.internal/r/docs/pull/1243) referencing action ID c317f9.

deploy-bot: Rollout progressing for non-pinned tenants: current slice 25% -> 50% after monitoring window.

Kai: monitoring green for non-pinned tenants, no uplift in 4xx or 5xx. I'll keep eyes for next 45m.

Ethan: logging snippet from the integration test that flagged this:
```
[2026-03-23T01:22:02Z] parse_error client=server-sdk-0.9.4 tenant=tenant-8 path=/v2/complete error="unknown key meta" req_id=xx12
[2026-03-23T01:22:02Z] http 400 tenant=tenant-8 upstream=ok latency=32ms
```

Nadia: closing thread: pins applied, rollout continues for others, docs PR up, runtime shim + SDK follow-up scheduled. Will unpin after SDK bump and validation window. :white_check_mark:
